visualize_point_cloud: create a mayavi 3D figure to visualize a point cloud with optional intensity coloring and origin axes
draw_3d_bounding_boxes: draw 3D bounding box corners on a mayavi figure with optional score labels and color coding
convert_boxes_to_corners: convert 3D bounding boxes in center format to 8 corner coordinates with rotation applied
rotate_points_along_z: rotate a batch of 3D points around the z-axis by a given angle using torch
render_full_detection_scene: render a complete LiDAR scene with point cloud, ground truth boxes, and predicted detection boxes
